intro.headline: A clearer next step starts here
intro.body: Share a few basic details about a vehicle accident. Sofia, the Do I Have a Case? AI intake specialist, may follow up to help identify a possible next step. This is an intake and matching service, not legal advice.

completion.headline: Your information was received
